generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of car repair garage (汽车维修车间). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Show a bright independent repair garage from a low front-left viewpoint. One car rests securely on a two-post lift with its bonnet fully raised. The upper third contains the lift columns and bonnet; the middle gives an unobstructed view into the engine bay, with the engine block, battery and translucent coolant reservoir clearly separated. A mechanic stands at the side rather than in front of the engine. Place the creeper, trolley jack, torque wrench and oil drain pan as distinct objects across the clean foreground floor. Cool daylight mixed with practical workshop lighting, mild grease and wear but no clutter.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: vehicle lift, open bonnet, engine block, car battery, coolant reservoir, mechanic creeper, trolley jack, torque wrench, oil drain pan, car mechanic.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
